case: invalidate — an archive with no version stamp
why: The DEFAULT state, not an exotic one: TBP carries no version field on a checkpoint id, so an adapter that does not stamp the axes itself produces exactly this. An archive that cannot be proven to match is not restored.

archive.note: A Go-Explore archive entry. TBP's save_checkpoint response carries {id, tier, frame, latency_ms, bytes, level} and no version field, so these axes are stamped by the adapter alongside the id.
